messages:
sam: Heads-up: new PTQ canary (harbor-mini-int8) shows a concentrated spike in funcall JSON parse failures for multi-turn streaming flows (8.3% vs 0.6% fp16).

canary-bot: Canary alert: funcall_parse_failure_rate=8.3% (5m) for harbor-mini-int8-canary. Dashboard: https://canary.internal/harbor-mini-int8

ren: can you paste one minimal raw concatenated stream example? helps determine cutoff vs malformed generation.

sam: pasted (concatenated chunks): `{"action":"stage","args":{"step":3,"status":"ok"}

{"action":"notify","args":{"user":"u9","msg":"done"}}` — note missing closing brace after first object.

izzy: that looks like an EOS/token cutoff mid-object. harbor-mini used PTQ int8 + streaming + kvcache reuse in this canary. Did we change tokenizer special handling in quant pipeline?

benchbot: quick numbers (sample 400 multi-turn sessions): fp16 parse_fail=0.5%, int8 parse_fail=8.3%, repaired_by_cut=2.1%, unrepaired=6.2%.

ren: immediate mitigation: implement a conservative resolver that tries a cheap last-object cut and only accepts repairs that preserve top-level action checksum. Also emit repair_confidence and repaired_changed_action_count.

izzy: agree. Also collect last N token ids (N=8) for failed sessions to S3 for offline tokenizer bisect vs fp16. That should show whether quant changes token ids near object boundaries.

sam: plan: (1) enable token-id dumps for 1% sample, (2) run grid streaming on/off x kvcache reuse on/off x batch sizes 1/4 for 2k sessions, (3) push parser-rescue behind feature flag returning tags: ok/repaired/failed + repair_confidence + action_checksum_delta. If repairs exceed 5% of sessions, pause int8 streaming.

ren: also add metric repaired_but_semantic_delta where top-level action differs after repair; we should never auto-apply repairs for high-risk actions (delete, transfer).

izzy: I'll start the grid and token dump job now, will upload a sanitized sample of failed payloads + token ids here.

sam: thanks. tl;dr: PTQ streaming canary -> parse regressions. Short-term: conservative repair + telemetry + token-id dumps. Medium-term: tokenizer bisect and PTQ pipeline review before broader rollout.
